017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.sse;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.AssertionUtils.*;
020import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
021import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.StringUtils.*;
022
023import java.util.*;
024import java.util.concurrent.*;
025import java.util.concurrent.atomic.*;
026import java.util.function.*;
027
028import org.apache.juneau.marshall.sse.*;
029
030/**
031 * Subscriber queue for an {@link SseBroadcaster}.
032 */
033public class SseSubscription implements AutoCloseable, Iterable<SseEvent> {
034
035   private final String id;
036   private final LinkedBlockingDeque<SseEvent> queue;
037   private final AtomicBoolean closed;
038   private final Consumer<String> closeCallback;
039   // Serializes the drop-oldest retry loop in offer() across concurrent producers, so one producer's
040   // pollFirst()/offerLast() retry can't interleave with another's and evict a just-inserted event instead
041   // of the true oldest one.
042   private final Object offerLock = new Object();
043
044   SseSubscription(String id, int queueSize, Consumer<String> closeCallback) {
045      if (isEmpty(id))
046         throw iaex("id cannot be null or empty.");
047      this.id = id;
048      this.queue = new LinkedBlockingDeque<>(queueSize);
049      this.closeCallback = assertArgNotNull("closeCallback", closeCallback);
050      closed = new AtomicBoolean(false);
051   }
052
053   /**
054    * The subscriber identifier.
055    *
056    * @return The subscriber identifier.
057    */
058   public String getId() {
059      return id;
060   }
061
062   /**
063    * Returns whether this subscription has been closed.
064    *
065    * @return {@code true} if this subscription has been closed.
066    */
067   public boolean isClosed() {
068      return closed.get();
069   }
070
071   boolean offer(SseEvent event) {
072      if (isClosed())
073         return false;
074      synchronized (offerLock) {
075         var dropped = false;
076         while (! queue.offerLast(event)) {
077            queue.pollFirst();
078            dropped = true;
079         }
080         return dropped;
081      }
082   }
083
084   /**
085    * Blocks until the next event is available.
086    *
087    * @return The next event.
088    * @throws InterruptedException If the wait was interrupted.
089    */
090   public SseEvent take() throws InterruptedException {
091      return queue.takeFirst();
092   }
093
094   @Override /* Iterable */
095   public Iterator<SseEvent> iterator() {
096      return new Iterator<>() {
097         @Override
098         public boolean hasNext() {
099            return ! isClosed();
100         }
101
102         @Override
103         public SseEvent next() {
104            try {
105               return take();
106            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
107               Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
108               throw new NoSuchElementException("Interrupted while waiting for SSE event.");
109            }
110         }
111      };
112   }
113
114   @Override /* AutoCloseable */
115   public void close() {
116      if (closed.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
117         queue.clear();
118         closeCallback.accept(id);
119      }
120   }
121}
